text:
lucas: Quick round 10: dark-mode tweak request. Heatmap color stops read fine but legend labels are vague. Users ask what bins mean.

anya: Agree. Add numeric ticks and unit label (eg 'Tokens / bucket'). Also suggest swapping the mid-tone from amber to a muted coral so its not confused with alerts.

diego: For code panel: current 'type' token is too light. Propose #8f7dde for types and make strings slightly warmer. Also re-evaluate inline code bg add 1px inset to separate from card bg.

rachel: Accessibility catch: rely on color + position for heatmap is bad for screen readers. Add aria-hidden=false titles for each cell and a summarized aria-describedby for the legend. Also add a high-contrast toggle in profile settings.

design-bot: Quick contrast scan: proposed type token #8f7dde vs code-bg #090b0d => 4.7:1 PASS. Heatmap mid-tone coral #ff9f87 vs bg => 3.9:1 WARN for small text in legend. Recommend increasing brightness or adding bold labels.

lucas: Plan: anya will prototype legend ticks + unit copy, diego will update code token hues and the inline bg, rachel will spec aria changes + high-contrast pref. Well test with colorblind sim and ship after QA. :thumbsup:
